name: Nguyen Tieu at Chua Ong
summary: People come to Chùa Ông, at 24 Trần Phú, on the 16th of the first lunar month. The city page describes worship at the temple. A 2026 plan waived sightseeing tickets for named halls across that festival only. Next year’s civil dates, and any waiver, are check on arrival.
when: The 16th of the first lunar month. The civil date is check on arrival.
